pins.name: IMU_SDA
pins.label: IMU_SDA (GPIO12)
pins.notes: IMU_SDA / PIN_WIRE0_SDA — dedicated I2C0 data line to the onboard LSM6DSMTR 6-axis IMU only. Absent from this board's own D1-D18 general-purpose pin list (only 18 of 22 used GPIOs are header-broken-out per the vendor's own '18 I/O pins' spec). Confirmed via github.com/Breadstick-Innovations/Raspberry-Breadstick product description (LSM6DSMTR IMU) and this repo's LSM6DS3TR.kicad_sch hierarchical label 'IMU_SDA' matching this board's own pins_arduino.h alias verbatim. i2c_sda bus capability still auto-supplied by build_boards.js from the genuine PIN_WIRE0_SDA alias.

pins.name: IMU_SCL
pins.label: IMU_SCL (GPIO13)
pins.notes: IMU_SCL / PIN_WIRE0_SCL — dedicated I2C0 clock line to the onboard LSM6DSMTR 6-axis IMU only. Same sourcing/reasoning as GPIO12 ('IMU_SCL' hierarchical label in LSM6DS3TR.kicad_sch); i2c_scl bus capability still auto-supplied by build_boards.js from the genuine PIN_WIRE0_SCL alias.

pins.name: DOTSTAR_CLOCK
pins.label: DOTSTAR_CLOCK (GPIO16)
pins.notes: DOTSTAR_CLOCK — dedicated clock line for the onboard 24x SK9822 (APA102/DotStar-protocol, 2-wire) addressable RGB LED strip. Absent from this board's own D1-D18 general-purpose pin list. Confirmed via the Breadstick-Innovations repo/Crowd Supply/Electromaker product descriptions (24x SK9822 LEDs, Data+Clock) and this repo's SK9822_RGB_LED_Strip.kicad_sch hierarchical label 'LED_CLK'. No led_neopixel tag applied - that tag is documented (PinType.js) as a WS2812-style single-wire data pin, which would misrepresent this board's genuine 2-wire clocked DotStar protocol; no dedicated DotStar/APA102 capability tag exists in this repo's vocabulary. Output-only, not general-purpose, no SPI/I2C bus alias in pins_arduino.h either (bit-banged/PIO-driven, not hardware peripheral), matching the adafruit_feather_prop_maker PIN_I2S_BIT_CLOCK dedicated-line exclusion precedent.

pins.name: DOTSTAR_DATA
pins.label: DOTSTAR_DATA (GPIO17)
pins.notes: DOTSTAR_DATA — dedicated data line for the same onboard 24x SK9822 (APA102/DotStar-protocol) addressable RGB LED strip as GPIO16. Absent from this board's own D1-D18 general-purpose pin list. Same sourcing as GPIO16 (SK9822_RGB_LED_Strip.kicad_sch hierarchical label 'LED_DATA'). No led_neopixel tag applied for the same WS2812-vs-DotStar protocol-mismatch reason given for GPIO16 above.
